description: This file defines the class EntityUntranslatableFieldsConstraintValidator, which validates constraints related to untranslatable fields in Drupal entities, particularly for multilingual and revisionable entities. It implements validation logic to prevent unintentional changes to untranslatable fields in certain revision states.

classes.name: EntityUntranslatableFieldsConstraintValidator
classes.description: A validator class for checking untranslatable fields in Drupal entities, ensuring compliance with multilingual and revision constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the entity type manager dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance using the service container.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the entity to check for untranslatable field changes and adds violations if constraints are violated.

methods.name: hasUntranslatableFieldsChanges
methods.description: Checks if the entity has changes in untranslatable fields compared to its original revision.
